remarks: Welcome to 601 Foxboro Drive! This 1 bedroom, 1 1/2 bathroom condo, in the highly sought after Foxboro Court Complex, has beautiful, hardwood floors and lots of natural sunlight. A private, covered deck off the living room allows for relaxing in the fresh air. In addition to the living room, this home provides a dining room, kitchen and primary suite on the main level. The lower level includes a washer and dryer, access to the garage as well as ample storage space or home office set-up. Enjoy the community pool and a location that's convenient to major highways, trains, shopping, dining, and much more! Excellent credit a must.
